Sasha: Drafting the internal release note for 2.3.1 — canary tomorrow 01:00-03:00 UTC. Pinning suggestion: v2.3.1. Wanted quick alignment on rollback criteria and who sends the internal blast.

Sasha: "Deploy 2.3.1 — performance and stability fixes for the serving runtime. No schema changes. Expected low risk."

Maria: LGTM, small wording tweak: change "No schema changes" -> "No API schema changes".

Kevin: +1. Rollback criteria proposal: error-rate > 5% OR median latency +30% sustained for 10m. If triggered, ops to run rollback command. Who's owning rollback during canary?

Olivia: I'll own the internal blast (ops). Can we embargo external docs until canary clears? Prefer T+24h for public docs.

Sasha: Confirmed: wording updated to "No API schema changes." @olivia please send internal at T+15 after canary success. Pin: v2.3.1.

deploy-bot: SCHEDULED: canary deploy for service 'rt-inference' at 1708514400. Command queued: `/deploy canary rt-inference v2.3.1 --window 01:00-03:00UTC --pin`

Kevin: Rollback command for ops: `/deploy rollback rt-inference previous` — run if criteria met. Quick runbook: https://go/release/runbook/rt-inference

Maria: Add privacy line for legal: "No customer data migration required." Legal gave verbal ok.

Sasha: Final internal snippet (ready to post):

Sasha: "Release 2.3.1: runtime performance and stability fixes. No API schema changes. No customer data migration. Canary: 01:00-03:00 UTC. Rollback criteria: error rate >5% or latency +30% sustained 10m. Ops contact: @olivia."

Olivia: I'll schedule the post and monitor oncall. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: REMINDER: will post deploy start at 1708514400 and send heartbeat updates every 5m. React with :rocket: if you're good.
